vision.name: Blue Wish
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(If this card is discarded from your hand by a Mastery effect, you may banish it to shuffle a Setup, Drill, or attached card in play into its owner's Life Deck.)
[Instant] POWER: Use at the end of any turn. Discard a card from your hand to search your discard pile for an Ally and play it.
POWER: Lower your opponent's anger 2.
(Banish after use.)
(Created by Ty Tracey, OP3 West Kai Champion)
